DotaBased Replay — distribution notices

Project source and releases
https://github.com/svenski88/dotabased_replay
The project's original source is publicly viewable. An open-source license has
not been granted for the project code. The items below retain their own terms.
https://dotabased.com/

Valve artwork and game files
Dota 2 hero artwork © Valve Corporation. All rights reserved. The project uses
the artwork for non-commercial fan-created replay visualization. DotaBased
Replay is an independent community project with no Valve affiliation or
endorsement. The project grants no redistribution rights for Valve assets.
Steam provides game client files separately through DepotDownloader.
See _internal/assets/valve/heroes/LICENSE.txt for the artwork notice.
https://store.steampowered.com/subscriber_agreement/#2

Prediction model
TheWonderCow's micro19 model was obtained from his Patreon and is included
with permission. DotaBased Replay grants no rights to the model.
Win probabilities are estimates from the model.
https://www.patreon.com/TheWonderCow

Data references and external tools
SteamDB provides build and manifest references. SteamTracking and Valve's
patch notes help corroborate historical builds. The OpenDota dotaconstants
hero manifest supplies hero metadata. OpenDota lookups are optional, and the
app opens Dotabuff match pages when requested. DepotDownloader handles Steam
sign-in and fetches selected game files directly from Steam.
https://steamdb.info/
https://github.com/SteamTracking/GameTracking-Dota2
https://github.com/odota/dotaconstants
https://www.opendota.com/
https://www.dotabuff.com/
https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader

Bundled software
The native replay helper uses Manta. Model inference uses LightGBM and NumPy.
The Windows app bundles Python and Tcl/Tk using PyInstaller. Parser and
inference dependency licenses are available in _internal/third_party/ and in
the About dialog under Third-party notices.
https://github.com/dotabuff/manta
https://lightgbm.readthedocs.io/
https://numpy.org/
https://www.python.org/
https://www.tcl-lang.org/
https://pyinstaller.org/
